mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness prompting central bank rate cuts, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods, or signal fails to outperform random walk in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term coefficient not significant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 105 and UNRATE < 3.0%), stretched equity valuations from overheating manufacturing and labor markets cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or regime-specific return difference not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units for two consecutive months signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or signal's predictive power not significant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) and nonfarm payrolls declines (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint increase in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in >60% of cases, or interaction term not significant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling regression.
